items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 你好，请尽量简洁地说明你的来意。嗯？不是公事？那我反而更紧张了。 坐下详谈吧。顺便一提，你可以称呼我「公爵」，他们都是这么叫的，我也听习惯了。
items.text_en: Hello, please try to quickly summarize your intents and goals for this meeting. Oh? You're not here for business? Well, that just makes me even more nervous.Alright, then perhaps we should sit down and discuss things in a little more detail... Oh, and you can call me "Your Grace." That's what they all call me down in the Fortress, and... well, I kinda got used to it.

items.title: 闲聊·贴纸
items.text: 如果看到我背后粘着美露莘画的贴纸，帮我揭掉吧？
items.text_en: If you ever see any stickers on my back, do me a favor and take them off... Melusines like to play pranks sometimes.

items.title: 闲聊·宠物
items.text: 我曾经考虑过要不要在办公室里养宠物，但小猫小狗在不见阳光的地方生活太可怜了。还是算了吧。
items.text_en: I once considered keeping some pets in my office, but soon gave up on the idea. It's just not right to keep small animals where they won't be able to see the sun.

items.title: 闲聊·忠告
items.text: 不要违法。还有什么需要叮嘱的吗？哦对了，不要违法。
items.text_en: Word of advice: Don't break the law. Hmm, is there anything else? Oh, yeah... Seriously, don't break the law.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 下雨了？还好。要是在梅洛彼得堡感到头顶滴水的话，问题可就大了。
items.text_en: Oh, it's raining? That's alright. A real problem would be if we could feel water dripping on our heads in the Fortress of Meropide.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 心中无罪的人，在这种天气下也能安睡吧。
items.text_en: You know, they say if you're scared of the thunder, it's really because you've got something else to hide.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 嗯…和水下的冷不太一样。
items.text_en: Hmm... This is a different kind of cold than what I'm used to.

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 「太阳之下无新事」，但可以找个好地方野餐。
items.text_en: They say there's nothing new under the sun, but somehow a picnic in the warm sunshine never gets old.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早。晨报上的天气预测怎么说？
items.text_en: Morning. What do the papers have to say about today's weather forecast?

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 现在特许食堂人正多，我叫人送餐到办公室来吧。
items.text_en: The Coupon Cafeteria is probably crowded right now. I'll have someone deliver the food straight to my office.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 都这个时间了？总觉得才刚刚喝过下午茶。
items.text_en: Huh, is it evening already? Could have sworn I'd just had my afternoon tea.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 晚安。我要等会儿再睡，趁夜深人静正好算几笔账。
items.text_en: Good night. I'll be staying up for a little while yet — want to run some numbers while everything's nice and quiet.

items.title: 关于莱欧斯利自己·误解
items.text: 他们不是把我想得太神秘，就是太全能了。我只有一双眼睛、一对耳朵，怎么可能照顾到梅洛彼得堡的每一个角落呢。
items.text_en: People have this tendency to see me as an all-knowing figure with mystical powers. In reality, I'm just one man with two eyes and two ears. How can I possibly know everything that's happening in the Fortress of Meropide?

items.title: 关于莱欧斯利自己·小憩
items.text: 我早已服完刑，现在是自由公民，当然可以来水上闲逛。 不必担忧。要是梅洛彼得堡必须要我一直待在下面才能稳定运转，那也太不健康了。
items.text_en: I finished serving my sentence long ago, so there's nothing stopping me from taking an occasional breather in the overworld as a free citizen.Ah, there's no need to worry... The Fortress of Meropide doesn't currently have any problem so big as to require my round-the-clock presence to operate effectively.

items.title: 关于我们·收监
items.text: 我对很多人的第一印象都是从收监登记表开始的，看来你也没能例外。
items.text_en: I form my first impressions of many people based on the contents of their inmate registration papers. Seems like you're no exception to the rule.

items.title: 关于我们·出狱
items.title_en: About Us: Finishing the Jail Term
items.text: 都说没了利益牵扯才好做朋友，我们可以现在开始。
items.text_en: They say it's best to begin a friendship when there's no conflict of interest. Seems like the appropriate time has come.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 我以前跟一些罪人学过借助化学药剂使用元素的方法。无论「神之眼」的发放归哪个部门管，他们似乎不是很介意这点僭越之举。
items.text_en: Some inmates once taught me a way to wield the elements by throwing around chemical potions. I guess whoever's in charge of handing out Visions doesn't care too much about a little rule-bending.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 知道怎么做更容易逃脱警备队的抓捕吗？给自己起个又长又难记的名字，然后他们在大喊「那个谁，把手举起来！」时就会卡壳。
items.text_en: Want a tip on how to escape from the Gardes? Just give yourself a name that's really long and difficult to pronounce. They'll be stumbling over your name as soon as they try to announce that you are under arrest.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 「不劳动者不得食」，这句话很久以前就刷在梅洛彼得堡墙上了。我也不知道是谁安排的，在水下的确很实用。
items.text_en: "If a man will not work, he shall not eat." This phrase has been on the walls of the Fortress of Meropide for as long as anyone can remember. I don't know who first came up with it, but it's been pretty useful in the underworld.

items.title: 关于那维莱特
items.text: 记得有次被那维莱特叫去上面谈事情，走到沫芒宫门口正好看到他在路边淋雨。我替他打了伞，他礼貌地道了谢，表情却不大自然。我大概是打扰到了什么吧。
items.text_en: I was once summoned by Neuvillette to discuss some matters with him in his office. When I approached the Palais Mermonia, I saw him standing by the road, completely drenched in the rain. I held out an umbrella for him, and while he thanked me politely, his expression was a little... distressed, I guess. I can only assume that I had disturbed him in the middle of something.

items.title: 关于芙宁娜
items.text: 可能是因为我认罪太快，芙宁娜小姐在当年的审判中看起来兴致索然，早早就退场了。让水神大人失望可是大事，只好今后多给她送些好茶了。
items.text_en: Miss Furina displayed a severe lack of interest in my trial and excused herself early, probably because I pleaded guilty to all charges as soon as they were announced. Disappointing the Hydro Archon is a big deal, so... suppose I've got no choice but to keep gifting her copious amounts of the highest quality tea.

items.title: 关于希格雯
items.text: 希格雯护士长具备一名医护人员所需的全部美德，并关心着身边每一位同伴。 不过她似乎从我身上学走了一些坏习惯，比如时常和她的美露莘朋友们打赌，看谁能偷偷在我的东西上贴更多贴纸。不，我并不觉得困扰。
items.text_en: Sigewinne the head nurse possesses all the virtues associated with the medical profession and genuinely cares for the well-being of everyone around her.She seems to have picked up some bad habits from me, though, like frequently betting with her Melusine friends over who'd be able to put more stickers on my belongings. Hm? No, I'm not actually bothered by it.

items.title: 关于克洛琳德
items.text: 克洛琳德应该是你能找到的最好的决斗代理人了，实力有目共睹。我从未和她比试过，没有那个必要。
items.text_en: Clorinde is the best Champion Duelist you can find. Her combat prowess is already the stuff of legend. I've never fought her myself, but that's because there's never been a need for it.

items.title: 关于林尼
items.text: 我承认，拔除「壁炉之家」安插在水下的眼线是种挑衅。而他们的回应是只派几个孩子下来，的确令我有些难办。是真心觉得他们也可以被牺牲，还是看准了我不会对小孩下狠手呢…唉。
items.text_en: I'll admit that when I removed the House of the Hearth's spies in the underworld, that was kind of an intentional provocation to the Fatui. But their only response was to send down a bunch of children... Was it because they truly saw those kids as disposable? Or because they knew I wouldn't have it in me to let them come to serious harm? sigh

items.title: 关于娜维娅
items.text: 梅洛彼得堡和刺玫会有一些物资方面的合作，但仅限于此。并不是不信任娜维娅小姐或是质疑她的能力——实际上恰恰相反——只不过，我们之间水下水上的事务互不干涉是我与卡雷斯先生约好的规矩，维持不变就好。
items.text_en: The Fortress of Meropide works with Spina di Rosula on some matters regarding supplies and logistics, but we don't have any other dealings. This isn't because I don't trust Navia or her abilities, in fact, I hold her in quite high regard. The only reason we continue to stay out of each other's way is because I wanna honor the agreement I made with the late Mr. Callas.

items.title: 关于艾梅莉埃
items.text: 梅洛彼得堡应该用不上她的服务，有些痕迹就是作为「前车之鉴」被留下来的。…气味也是痕迹的一种，不是吗？
items.text_en: The Fortress of Meropide doesn't need her services. Yet some things are best preserved the way they are, warts and all, so people don't make the same mistakes twice... I say warts, but yeah. I mean the smell.

items.title: 关于夏沃蕾
items.text: 被特巡队关照过的犯人大多挺老实的，这位队长功不可没。
items.text_en: Most inmates seem to gain a new level of respect for the rules after receiving attention from the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol. As the captain, Chevreuse is an instrumental part of that team.

items.title: 想要了解莱欧斯利·其一
items.text: 理论上来讲，完全不认识我的人会比较幸福。
items.text_en: As a general rule, the less a person sees of me, the happier their life is.

items.title: 想要了解莱欧斯利·其二
items.text: 身上的疤痕？曾有深海巨兽企图占领梅洛彼得堡，我和它搏斗时被抓伤了。…当然是假的，不要信。
items.text_en: Hmm? Oh the scar on my body? It's from a gash I got while battling a gigantic undersea monster that tried to take over the Fortress of Meropide. ...Hah, just kidding.

items.title: 想要了解莱欧斯利·其三
items.text: 你知道吗，手铐只要型号相近，大部分都能用通用的钥匙打开。只有我这副不一样。
items.text_en: Did you know, many similar models of handcuffs can all be unlocked using the same master key? Except mine, of course. They're different.

items.title: 想要了解莱欧斯利·其四
items.text: 我的个人能力其实很有限。你看，我既不会治病，也不会搞发明，更不会造大船。我只是知道该去哪里找人做这些事，而他们恰好愿意卖我这个面子而已。
items.text_en: Honestly, my personal abilities are pretty limited. I got no talent in medicine, inventions, or ship-making. But what I do know how to do is find those people with those talents, and get 'em to come work for me.

items.title: 想要了解莱欧斯利·其五
items.text: 我现在过上了还不错的生活，但也仍然羡慕一些我得不到的东西——比如安逸快乐的童年，和轻易信赖他人的能力。可能有人认为这很矛盾，或者难以启齿，我倒觉得没什么不好承认的——何必和自己的本心过不去呢？
items.text_en: I've managed to get myself to a pretty comfortable place in life, but there's still some things I want that are outside my reach, like a peaceful and happy childhood, or the ability to trust other people. Maybe some people would see those feelings as shameful or contradictory, but I don't see a problem with sharing them. After all, why should anybody be afraid to admit what they want?

items.title: 莱欧斯利的爱好
items.text: 拳击？不算是爱好吧，只是生活所需。你有什么其他推荐吗？
items.text_en: Boxing? To me, that's more of a necessity than a hobby. You got some suggestions for actual hobbies?

items.title: 莱欧斯利的烦恼
items.text: 我确实有着枫丹人的长相，但没法百分之百肯定——只能跳胎海水确认咯？
items.text_en: While I do possess some stereotypical Fontainian looks, when you're an orphan, you can never really be sure where you're from. Who knows, maybe I'll take a dip in the Primordial Sea one of these days just to check...

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 喝咖啡时我习惯加奶，茶的话，两块糖就好了。
items.text_en: I usually take some milk with my coffee and two cubes of sugar with my tea.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 你喝过护士长做的奶昔吗？能从中尝出…「荒芜」的味道。
items.text_en: Have you ever had one of Sigewinne's milkshakes? The taste that comes to mind is... what's that flavor... desolation.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 完美的调味，我就不擅长这个。
items.text_en: What a perfect blend of flavors. I could have never made this myself.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 好吃。下次换我请客。
items.text_en: Lovely. I'll be sure to treat you to something next time.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 等我去泡杯茶。
items.text_en: Please excuse me, I'm... I'm gonna brew a cup of tea.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 枫丹的孩子是伴随着双亲的心愿与祝福诞生的，不过我愿意相信这世上的每一个人都是如此。和这个比起来，我的祝愿就有些微不足道了。 不，如果你犯事的话我是没办法帮你减刑的，只能在今天给你安排一份特殊的福利餐。所以生日期间还是安分一点，保证我们可以在水上庆祝，好吗？
items.text_en: Our tradition says that all children of Fontaine are born amid their parents' wishes and blessings, but I'd like to think that all children are born from such wonderful feelings. Anything that I can say to celebrate your birth would feel a little trivial next to that, right?Unfortunately, I won't be able to reduce your prison sentence if you were to commit a crime — the only thing I would be able to pull off would be a special Welfare Meal for your birthday dinner. With all that in mind, why don't you try to respect the law a bit more around your birthday, so we'll be able to celebrate somewhere nice on the surface?

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 能获得你的信任，是我的荣幸。
items.text_en: It is my honor to win your trust.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 这下必须还你一个人情了。
items.text_en: Uh oh, looks like I'll owe you a favor now.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 哈，你怎么看起来比我要得意？
items.text_en: Ha, why do you look even more pleased about this than me?

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 我喜欢力量和希望的信号，会让我感觉未来一切向好。这并非悲观，只是陈述事实，因为现实本就不可能一帆风顺。但有个好消息，就是当坏事发生时，我们可以站在同一阵线，对吧？
items.text_en: I like signs of strength and hope. They give me reassurance that tomorrow will be better than today. This isn't to be pessimistic, but it's impossible for the present to be without its doubts and troubles — that's just the truth. But come hell or high water, if nothing else then at least we'll be able to figure it out together, right?

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 开始吧。
items.text_en: Let's begin.

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 别跑啊。
items.text_en: Don't run away now.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 请留步。
items.text_en: A moment, please.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 一路顺风。
items.text_en: Have a safe trip.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 注意防寒。
items.text_en: This could get a little chilly.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 无需畏惧，直面罪责。
items.text_en: Stay cool and face your guilt!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 没有锁吗？真方便啊。
items.text_en: Oh, this wasn't locked? How convenient.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 先收好吧，总能派上用场。
items.text_en: I'd take it if I were you. I'm sure it'll come in handy.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 无主之物最好归公…所以这里什么都没有，对吧？
items.text_en: All unclaimed articles should be turned in, so... neither of us saw anything here, right?

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 不慌。
items.text_en: No need to fear.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 不叫增援？也行。
items.text_en: No backup, huh? Fine by me.

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 见机行事。
items.text_en: Time to improvise.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 退后。
items.text_en: Step back.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 去医务室。
items.text_en: Get to the infirmary.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 抱歉，没能守住…
items.text_en: Sorry... I couldn't protect...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 孤注一掷的后果…
items.text_en: Instead of going big, guess I'm going home...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 我没有异议。
items.text_en: I have... no objections.

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 这么客气？
items.text_en: Going easy on me?

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: …还可以。
items.text_en: ...Not bad.

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 开工。
items.text_en: Let's get to work.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 请我出外勤？走。
items.text_en: Got a side job for me? Sure thing.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 我尽力，但不保证赢。
items.text_en: I'll do my best, but I can't guarantee you victory.
